excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, VAST, a leading global general artificial intelligence company, announced the completion of Series A+ and Series A++ financing rounds, totaling nearly $200 million. This round was led by H Capital and China Life Yangtze River Delta Science and Technology Innovation Fund, with participation from industry investors such as the Shenzhen Artificial Intelligence Terminal Industry Fund (whose industry partner is the global leading terminal manufacturer Honor), renowned industry strategic investors, and Shanghai Semiconductor Industry Investment Fund, as well as top-tier financial investors including Shenzhen Capital Group, Yunsheng Capital, Wofu Ventures, and Fangguang Capital. The investor base brings together leading market-oriented funds, state-owned platforms, and industry leaders, forming a diversified empowerment system. Meanwhile, existing shareholders such as Primavera Venture Capital, Yacoba Capital, BV Baidu Ventures, and Dongfang Jiafu continued to oversubscribe. This marks VAST's second capital injection within two months, following its financing in March this year.  

At the same time, VAST unveiled its new world model project—Project Eden. Unlike conventional approaches in the industry, such as "action-conditioned video generation" and "static 3D scene generation," Project Eden innovatively decouples underlying state inference from visual presentation at a fundamental level. This breakthrough makes it the world's first world model that allows autonomous maintenance and deterministic control of world states, naturally unlocking disruptive capabilities such as long-term environmental persistence, free reuse of scenes, and multi-user concurrent interaction. Project Eden aims to serve as the next-generation low-barrier underlying engine for interactive content creation, while also providing highly logically consistent training and evaluation environments for embodied intelligence and other intelligent agents.

Los inversores reúnen a fondos de mercado líderes, plataformas estatales y gigantes industriales estratégicos, formando un sistema diversificado de apoyo. Además, antiguos accionistas como Chunhua Venture Capital, Jingya Capital, BV Baidu Ventures y Dongfang Jiafu también realizaron inversiones adicionales por encima de lo previsto.

excerpt_i18n.en: Author | Wu You Editor | Liu Wei On May 27, BEYOND Expo 2026 opened in Macau, with this year's exhibition centered on the core theme of AI: Digital-Physical Symbiosis. Nearly 800 global enterprises showcased the latest achievements of AI transitioning from digital systems to physical entities. After visiting over 20 booths, Leiphone found that the industry is shifting from concept hype to scenario implementation and vertical deep cultivation. AI hardware is no longer competing for "comprehensiveness" but for precision, user experience, and business closure in niche scenarios. Foundational and terminal manufacturers are actively taking next steps, as AI enters the physical world. He Jiandong, co-founder of BEYOND Expo, stated at the opening ceremony that Asia, with its strengths in software model innovation, advanced manufacturing, and hardware supply chain capabilities, is the core battleground for Physical AI implementation—digital intelligence must be grounded in reality, requiring chips, hardware, and manufacturing systems as its foundation. The most direct signal on-site was that both foundational and terminal manufacturers are actively taking next steps: Deepu Talla, NVIDIA's Vice President of Robotics and Edge AI, mentioned in his keynote that in digital AI scenarios like ChatGPT and Gemini, models achieve only 95% or even 99% accuracy, with humans filling the final 1%. However, applying AI to robotics has always been challenging due to the field's high precision requirements, and related technologies have only recently matured. NVIDIA can now provide computing power and parameters.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor: Wu You | Editor: Liu Wei. El 27 de mayo, la BEYOND Expo 2026 se inauguró en Macao. La exposición, centrada en el tema central "IA: Simbiosis Digital y Física", reunió a casi 800 empresas globales que mostraron los últimos avances de la IA al pasar de los sistemas digitales a entidades físicas. Tras visitar más de 20 puestos en el lugar, Leiphone.com descubrió que la industria está pasando del bombo conceptual a la implementación en escenarios reales y la especialización vertical. El hardware de IA ya no compite por ser "grande y completo", sino por precisión, experiencia y cierre comercial en nichos específicos. Los fabricantes de infraestructura y terminales están tomando medidas proactivas. La IA entra en el mundo físico. Cofundador de BEYOND Expo.

Real Robots.
